name: Jill Levi
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in New York, New York
side_practice_areas: Business Litigation, Construction Litigation, Creditor Debtor Rights
about: A member of Todd & Levi, L.L.P., located in New York, New York, Jill Levi focuses her practice in the areas of commercial litigation and transactions, providing representation to companies throughout the area. Some of the matters that she handles include general business disputes, creditor's rights, aircraft leasing and financing, and construction litigation. Ms. Levi is also the head of the firm's matrimonial practice group. In her construction dispute practice, she advises her clients on practical ways to protect their interests, such as the filing of liens and surety bond claims.

Ms. Levi graduated summa cum laude, phi beta kappa, with her Bachelor of Arts from Queens College in 1979 and went on to earn her Juris Doctor with honors from Hofstra University School of Law in 1982. During law school, she was an associate editor of the Hofstra Law Review. After graduation, she joined the litigation department of Paul Weiss Rifkind Wharton & Garrison and was then a litigation partner at another New York City firm before co-founding (twenty years ago), Todd & Levi, L.L.P Admitted to practice in New York since 1983, Ms. Levi is also admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern and Southern Districts of New York, the U.S. Courts of Appeals for the 2nd, 3rd and 5th Circuits, and the United States Tax Court.

Ms. Levi has offered support to several charitable organizations, including Susan G. Komen and the Legal Aid Society. Ms. Levi is also an active participant in the Association of the Bar of the City of New York and the New York State Bar Association.
honors: Super Lawyer in Commercial Business Litigation, 2013 - 2017
